comment: Lines of one NPC's own (tools/seed_npc_lines.py; entity/dialog.go): an NPC named here says these alone when
talked to with nothing else to say (no quest step, shop, route or sign), never the town pool, wherever it
stands and whatever its body. A block is a name and its lines, with a mood (neutral, friendly, warm, wary,
hostile, comma separated; none: a neutral, friendly or warm listener), a race (the listener's, -1 any) and a
weight as town_lines.json's; %p the listener's name, %r race, %c class, %t town, %n the speaker. Ours: the
user, 2026-11-01, "give him specific lines talking about his brother, etc. special dialog and not the pool",
"we can have pools per character if needed, especially for quest npcs".

blocks.name: Valrean V`Ghen
blocks.note: the tent below the outpost north of Neriak; Dragoon V`Ghen's brother; Lady Furess's Packages turns him on the player
say: My brother keeps the tower, and I keep the tent. He calls it duty. I call it waiting my turn.
Dragoon V`Ghen sees the whole road from up there, and still he cannot see what goes on under his own boots.
The firebats grow bold this season. Let the fresh ones out of the city burn their fingers on them; I have better things to watch.
Couriers come up this road from the docks every day, %r. Some of what they carry even reaches the people it was meant for.
Neriak sends its finest to stand watch over Nektulos. It sent my brother, too.
When my brother is called back to the city, this outpost will be mine. Remember whose tent you stood in, %p.
Mind the firebats on your way back to the city, %c. My brother hates scraping fools off his road.

blocks.name: Valrean V`Ghen
say: You have been seen with the wrong sort in Neriak, %r. Say what you want of a V`Ghen, or move along.

blocks.name: Valrean V`Ghen
say: Another step into my tent, %r, and my brother will find what is left of you in the morning.
